name: n8n
summary: Fair-code workflow automation platform for AI agents with 1,500+ integrations, an MCP Client node, MCP Server Trigger and a built-in instance-level MCP server.
description:
Combine a visual canvas with JavaScript/Python code, self-host (Docker: `docker run -it --rm -p 5678:5678 docker.n8n.io/n8nio/n8n`) or use n8n Cloud. AI features include agents with tools, memory and LLM providers; the **MCP Client** node lets workflows call MCP servers, the **MCP Server Trigger** node exposes a workflow as an MCP server, and the built-in instance-level MCP server lets Claude, Codex and other clients search, run, create and edit workflows (create/edit from n8n 2.13) and manage data tables. Latest release n8n@2.45.4 (2026-10-26).

**License:** Sustainable Use License (fair-code, not OSI open source); files with `.ee.` in the name need an n8n Enterprise License. GitHub reports it as NOASSERTION.

agent_access.notes: Instance-level MCP access is enabled per instance and clients authenticate to it (see 'Connect to n8n MCP server' in the docs); docs pages are available as markdown by appending .md.
